evidence: The B.11 interpretation is faithful for the complete real-domain comparison chain, visually checked on original PDF page 146 (exposition.txt splitlines 7782-7793). AxisModelBounds.model/model_eq_series (lines 16-21), AxisSeries.profile (174), and AxisProfile.cubicLower (84) identify the exact quoted sum and cubic; observed division and function arguments are Real. The mapped local z has the correct identity and type. For 0<=z<=41/10, t=z/2 lies in [0,41/20]; absolute convergence and decreasing alternating tails from degrees four and one establish respectively cubic<=f0 and f0<=1. c'(t)=-((t-4)^2+8)/48<0, c(41/20)=305719/1152000, and this exceeds 53/200 by 439/1152000. The extracted profile_bounds application supplies only endpoint lower/upper bounds, so the complete conclusion transfer explicitly also uses original cubic_lower_le_bessel and cubicLower_ge_endpoint plus rational arithmetic. All twelve original generated goals were copied unchanged and passed an independent pinned Lean replay on the second attempt; first tactic failures and raw receipts are preserved and are not refutations. All successful replay axiom lists omit sorryAx. The original AxisModelBounds source also re-elaborated. I classify the method as different only for the endpoint subargument: the Lean body proves endpoint minimality by a nonnegative polynomial expansion, whereas the prose invokes cubic monotonicity. Its alternating-series argument otherwise matches. This is a sound proof-method variation, not a mathematical error. For the parent positivity use, B.2 gives 0<=chi<=1, so f0(Y chi)>0.265 on the required real interval; positivity of nonlinear Phi still requires the separate uniform B.13 approximation with sufficiently large Lambda, and positivity of phi uses phi_*>0. This local review does not certify those existence/approximation dependencies or the whole proposition. Supporting details and exact replay receipts are in fresh-model-bound-review/supporting-reasoning.txt. No excluded evidence was accessed; no full native investigation check or fresh dependency-closure build is claimed.
